personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, industrial command-center built for speed, live stock visibility, and rugged floor operations.

spacing.rule: Use tight grids and deliberate paddings for high data density. Maintain rigid margins for all cards without floating effects.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary blocks with sharp 1px borders instead of glass. Data screens prioritize extreme readability.
dont's: No blur on dashboard cards or list rows.
No glassmorphism on the scanner overlay (use solid semi-transparent black).

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: A live metric-heavy view showing total stock value, active alerts, and quick actions.

states.loading: Skeleton grids with an industrial scan-line sweep effect.
states.empty: Illustration of stacked boxes with 'No Data Yet' and a prompt to sync inventory.
states.error: Red outlined box with error text and a prominent 'Retry Connection' button.

screens.layout: Four 2-column KPI metric cards at the top using Rajdhani font. Below, a scrollable list of recent stock updates and low stock alerts. Rigid 1px borders for all cards.

screens.name: Barcode Scanner
screens.purpose: Scan incoming orders or lookup items instantly.

states.loading: Centered loading spinner over the camera feed.
states.empty: N/A for camera, but 'Item Not Found' slide-up panel on failed scan.
states.error: Error panel describing why camera access failed or scan timed out.

screens.layout: Full-bleed camera view. Dark #121212 semi-transparent overlay covering non-scan areas. A sharp, white-lined bounding box for the target area. A bottom sheet (surfaceSecondary) for scanned item details that pops up upon successful scan.

screens.name: Product Catalog
screens.purpose: List, filter, and edit products, categories, and warehouses.

screens.name: Product Details & Edit
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a single product to edit supplier, price, stock count, and best-before dates.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Dark-First Utility guidelines. Use #121212 background with #1E1E1E cards.
Do NOT use glassmorphism or blur effects for data screens; rely on 1px #37474F borders to define hierarchy and components.
For typography, use Rajdhani for all metrics, numbers, KPIs, and main headers. Use IBM Plex Sans for tables, body copy, and UI text.
When designing the barcode scanner, use a full-bleed camera, a dark semi-transparent overlay outside the scan area, and a bright high-contrast scan frame.
Implement a status dot indicator (Green/Yellow/Red) for stock levels across all lists.
Ensure 'Save Changes' or 'Create Order' primary buttons are sticky at the bottom of forms/lists.
Barcode inputs should never be inverted; if there's a barcode visualization on screen, ensure it's on a white surface to maintain scanner compatibility.
Do NOT use blues or purples anywhere in the app. Stick to the Safety Orange (#FF5722) accent.
Ensure the bottom tabs use outlined inactive and filled active icons from MaterialCommunityIcons.
